name: Acoustic Guitar, Sparkle
description: A peak at 8 kHz for the strings, and less of the body under it.

name: Bass, Round Bottom
description: Boost and cut at once at 100 Hz, which fills a bass out and clears the low mids, with the top taken down a little.

name: Dark and Warm
description: The high cut from 10 kHz and a little more below: takes the edge off something bright or thin.

name: Kick, Lift and Dip
description: The low boost and cut at once at 60 Hz: weight under the kick, a dip above it, and a little click at 4 kHz.

name: Master, Both Ends
description: A little more at the very bottom and the very top, and the middle left alone.

name: Mix, Broad Top
description: The widest peak at 10 kHz, a couple of dB: a whole mix a little brighter, with no edge to it.

name: Sub Weight
description: Boost and cut at once at 30 Hz: the very bottom lifted, and what lies just above it held back.

name: Vocal, Air
description: A broad lift at 12 kHz that opens a voice up, with the lows eased off.
